description.zh:
消息内容。

**WhatsApp消息备注：**
-  当**messageType**为**text**时，**text**字段为必填，**Caption**禁止填写。
- 当**messageType**为**image**时，**Link**必填。
- 当**messageType**为**video**时，**Link**必填。
- 当**messageType**为**audio**时，**Link**必填，**Caption**字段无效。
- 当**messageType**为**document**时，**Link**和**FileName**字段必填，**Caption**字段无效。
- 当**messageType**为**interactive**时，**type**和**action**字段必填。
- 当**messageType**为**contacts**时，**name**字段必填。
- 当**messageType**为**location**时，**longitude**和**latitude**字段必填。
- 当**messageType**为**sticker**时，**Link**字段必填，**Caption**和**FileName**字段无效。
- 当**messageType**为**reaction**时，**messageId**和**emoji**字段必填。


**Messenger消息备注：**
- 当**messageType**为**text**时，**text**字段必填。
- 当**messageType**为**image**、**video**、**audio**、**document**时，**link**字段必填。

**Instagram消息备注：**
- 当**messageType**为**text**时，**text**字段必填。
- 当**messageType**为**image**、**video**、**audio**时，**link**字段必填。


<props="intl">**Viber消息备注：**</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**text**时，**text**字段必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**image**时，**link**字段必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**video**时，**link**、**thumbnail**、**fileSize**、**duration**字段必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**document**、**link**、**fileName**、**fileType**字段为必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**text_button**时，**text**、**caption**、**action**字段为必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**text_image_button**时，**text**、**link**、**caption**、**action**字段为必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**text_video**时，**text**、**link**、**thumbnail**、**fileSize**、**duration**字段为必填。</props>
<props="intl">- 当**messageType**为**text_video_button**时，**text**、**link**、**thumbnail**、**fileSize**、**duration**、**caption**字段为必填，**action**字段不能为值。</props>
description.en:
The message content.

**WhatsApp message notes:**
- If **messageType** is **text**, the **text** field is required and the **Caption** field must not be specified.
- If **messageType** is **image**, the **Link** field is required.
- If **messageType** is **video**, the **Link** field is required.
- If **messageType** is **audio**, the **Link** field is required and the **Caption** field is invalid.
- If **messageType** is **document**, the **Link** and **FileName** fields are required and the **Caption** field is invalid.
- If **messageType** is **interactive**, the **type** and **action** fields are required.
- If **messageType** is **contacts**, the **name** field is required.
- If **messageType** is **location**, the **longitude** and **latitude** fields are required.
- If **messageType** is **sticker**, the **Link** field is required and the **Caption** and **FileName** fields are invalid.
- If **messageType** is **reaction**, the **messageId** and **emoji** fields are required.


**Messenger message notes:**
- If **messageType** is **text**, the **text** field is required.
- If **messageType** is **image**, **video**, **audio**, or **document**, the **link** field is required.

**Instagram message notes:**
- If **messageType** is **text**, the **text** field is required.
- If **messageType** is **image**, **video**, or **audio**, the **link** field is required.


<props="intl">**Viber message notes:**</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **text**, the **text** field is required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **image**, the **link** field is required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **video**, the **link**, **thumbnail**, **fileSize**, and **duration** fields are required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **document**, the **link**, **fileName**, and **fileType** fields are required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **text_button**, the **text**, **caption**, and **action** fields are required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **text_image_button**, the **text**, **link**, **caption**, and **action** fields are required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **text_video**, the **text**, **link**, **thumbnail**, **fileSize**, and **duration** fields are required.</props>
<props="intl">- If **messageType** is **text_video_button**, the **text**, **link**, **thumbnail**, **fileSize**, **duration**, and **caption** fields are required, and the **action** field must not be empty.</props>

description.zh:
回落规则。此参数为国际站参数，中国站可忽略此参数。
</props><props="intl">取值：</props>
<props="intl">- **undelivered**：消息不能发送到端时进行回落（在发送状态时模板、参数需要校验通过，模板被封、号码被封等不做校验）。参数值为空时默认使用此规则。</props>
<props="intl">-  **sentFailed**：消息在校验模板、模板变量等参数时，校验不通过也会进行回落。只会强校验channelType, type, messageType, to, from(是否存在) 几个参数。</props>
description.en:
The fallback rule. This parameter is for the international site. China site users can ignore this parameter.
</props><props="intl">Valid values:</props>
<props="intl">- **undelivered**: fallback is triggered when the message cannot be delivered to the device (template and parameter validation must pass at the sending stage; template bans or number bans are not validated). This rule is used by default if the parameter value is empty.</props>
<props="intl">- **sentFailed**: fallback is also triggered when template or template variable validation fails. Only the channelType, type, messageType, to, and from (existence check) parameters are strictly validated.</props>

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口发送消息，也可在<props="china">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**消息发送**界面手动发送消息。

- 在调用此接口前。请确保您已成功创建通道，且已有审核通过的模板。

- WhatsApp通道类型需已完成[WABA注册及绑定](~~172335~~)、[新增号码](~~2656131~~)。
- Messenger通道类型需已完成[连接公共主页账号](~~2837713~~)。
- Instagram通道类型需已完成[连接专业账户账号](~~2837720~~)。

<props="intl">- Viber通道类型需已完成[申请服务号](~~2807995~~)。</props>

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为250次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。

### 状态变更
消息发送状态可以通过MNS/HTTP方式监听，具体请参考[回执消息](~~421545~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to send a message, or manually send a message on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Management** > **Send Message** page.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have created a channel and have an approved template.

- For the WhatsApp channel type, you must complete [WABA registration and bindng](~~172335~~) and [add a phone number](~~2656131~~).
- For the Messenger channel type, you must complete [connecting a public page account](~~2837713~~).
- For the Instagram channel type, you must complete [connecting a professional account](~~2837720~~).

<props="intl">- For the Viber channel type, you must complete [applying for a service ID](~~2807995~~).</props>

### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 250 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as needed.

### Status changes
You can monitor message delivery status through MNS or HTTP. For more information, see [Receipt messages](~~421545~~).
